result: Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/csv/ExtendedBufferedReaderAgentTest.java` with 26 self-contained JUnit 5 tests covering: initial state, single-char and array reads (normal, zero-length, EOF, short-underlying-read looping via an in-file `ChunkedReader`), peek (single and array variants, including EOF and empty-array cases), mark/reset, line-number tracking (plain, CR/LF/CRLF, EOF without trailing EOL), `readLine` terminator handling, close behavior, byte-tracking with/without a charset (UTF-8, UTF-16 BOM-subtraction, surrogate-pair encoding, and an unpaired low surrogate triggering `CharacterCodingException`), and a boundary case where `read(char[], ...)` at EOF moves `position` backward (actual current behavior of the class). All tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
